audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 disagreed across layers: phases[0].side = 'Akshan' but win[0] = 'Akali'. The page rendered two answers.
audit.why: Akshan is ranged with an 850-range Avengerang and a passive that fires a second auto on every attack; melee Akali cannot contest level 1. The rest of the chart (Akshan 2-4, Akali 5-7) and the 51.06% over 2025 games are consistent with Akshan owning level 1.
audit.corrected: win[0] flipped to Akshan to match the full layer, with whys[0] and the content 'early' block rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] credited Akshan's level 6 with 'a revive-support angle'. The revive is Going Rogue (W)'s Scoundrel passive, available from level 1 — it is not a level 6 spike. His 6 is Comeuppance.
audit.why: Riot text: W passively marks Scoundrels and resurrects allies; R locks on and fires stored bullets at 2500 range for missing-health damage, hitting the first champion, minion or structure.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten around Comeuppance and the fact that any minion in the path eats it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the two interactions that decide this lane: Heroic Swing is broken by colliding with a champion, and Twilight Shroud reveals Akshan out of Going Rogue's camouflage. Comeuppance being minion-blockable was also absent.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain'. Owner W flag revealsStealth, and Riot's W text puts Akshan in camouflage. Riot's R text: damage lands on 'the first champion, minion, or structure hit'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[2].d now carry all three, with the 18s rank-1 Heroic Swing cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization told the player to buy anti-heal early 'into his sustain'. Dirty Fighting grants a shield, not healing — Grievous Wounds does nothing to it.
audit.why: Riot P text: every third hit 'grants him a Shield'. No heal anywhere in the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown section gave no numbers and repeated a generic 'fight while it is down'.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 — an 18s window at rank 1 is a real, countable green light.
No elo tiers present anywhere in the current text; none introduced.

edits.before: You can punish Akshan's early trade pattern before his shield stabilizes his sustain
edits.after: Akshan pokes from 850 range with Avengerang and you cannot reach him without spending E

edits.before: You can actually punish Akshan's melee-range Q-auto combo at level 1 if you play the trade correctly, since his shield only comes up once his passive resets, giving you a small window to bully him off CS before he settles into his rhythm.
edits.after: Akshan owns level 1: Avengerang out-ranges everything you have at 850 and his passive fires a second auto on every attack, so stepping up costs more than it wins — farm at Q range, bank energy, and wait for Twilight Shroud at 3 to buy your first real trade.

edits.before: Akshan 6 gives him global pressure and a revive-support angle that stabilizes his lane while he waits out your cooldowns.
edits.after: Akshan 6 adds Comeuppance, a 2500-range missing-health burst — but any minion between you eats it, so never take it in open lane.

edits.before: Use his ultimate for pick potential or to stall for scaling
edits.after: Fire Comeuppance at you in open lane where no minion blocks it

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Twilight Shroud spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and his only escape — he is knocked off it by colliding with a champion, so stand in the swing path and it ends early. - Going Rogue is camouflage, so close range gives him away. - Hold R for a decided fight.

edits.before: Track Akshan’s Heroic Swing: His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is engage and escape at 18s; body-block it and he falls off mid-swing. Going Rogue is camouflage, not true stealth.

edits.before: Akshan spends Heroic Swing early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Bait Heroic Swing, then commit — it is 18s at rank 1 and he has no other escape.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by deleting Akshan — no hard CC to stop you, and a body-block ends the Heroic Swing he escapes on.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield or Ring + pots. Riftmaker or Stormsurge-line first, Sorcerer's/Mercs, then Zhonya's into burst, Rabadon's after. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield or Ring + pots. Riftmaker or Stormsurge-line first, Sorcerer's/Mercs, then Zhonya's into burst, Rabadon's after. His passive shields rather than heals.
